name: KeyDoor
brief: A key-and-door puzzle: a room with a SpawnLocation, a key lying on the floor, and a locked door in a wall in front of a finish pad. The door opens only for a player who picked up the key.
contract: The key is a Part named Key (CanCollide false); touching it gives the player the key and removes the Key part.
The door is a Part named Door in a wall too high to jump over that blocks the whole room; the finish pad behind it is a Part named Goal.
When a player who has the key touches the Door, the door opens (non-collidable, transparent). Without the key it stays closed.
